narration.text: Every new hire screened for the Work Opportunity Tax Credit, inside 28 days. This is a chore for the office manager of a restaurant group of about sixty people in Columbus, Ohio, fourteen hires into the holiday season. Athena works it across 4 portals: Talentry ATS, Payroll Harbor, Mailnest and WorkCredit Online. On the bench, she found 5 of 5 eligible items, worth 19,200 dollars of the 19,200 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. Among them: A dishwasher in a SNAP household who began work on 5 November: his 28 days ended on 3 December. The owner's nephew, sent over by her: a relative earns no credit. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 3 hours, so she was about 60 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
